title: decode_detect
description: Decodes video on the GPU, applies an optional motion gate and runs object detection in a single stage, publishing detection events.

model_path.description: Path to the detection model loaded by the hardware backend.

input_size.description: Square network input size in pixels.

conf_threshold.description: Minimum confidence for a detection to be reported.

roi_motion.description: Run the motion gate and infer only on frames or regions that moved.

motion.description: Motion gate tunables; 0 or absent keeps the backend default.

downsample.description: Motion grid cell size in pixels.

pixel_threshold.description: Per-cell luma difference that counts as changed.

min_cells.description: Changed cells needed to count as motion.

luma_jump.description: Suppress whole-scene brightness jumps above this value.

max_regions.description: Maximum motion regions inferred per frame.

class_filter.description: Class ids to report; empty reports all classes.

stream_filter.description: Stream ids to process; empty processes every stream.

hw.description: Hardware backend; auto picks metal on Apple and tries cuda, vaapi, vulkan, openvino elsewhere.

decode_path.description: Path to the inner decode_ffmpeg library; defaults to plugins/decode_ffmpeg/decode_ffmpeg.dylib on macOS and .so elsewhere.

codec.description: Codec override passed to the inner decoder.
